nodes.text: Hi! I'm new barpony here, and you?

nodes.speaker: pony_gpt
nodes.text: I'm local data analyst and casual conversation specialist.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Am... you're some kind of scientist?

nodes.speaker: pony_gpt
nodes.text: Excellent question! You could say that.

nodes.speaker: pony_gpt
nodes.text: My main function is exploring the world around us, analyzing and collecting data.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Sounds complicated. Well, I just pour drinks...

nodes.speaker: pony_gpt
nodes.text: Incorrect statement! A good bartender is an algorithm of happiness.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Hm... nice to hear that. Maybe you should stop by sometime — we’ll test my "happiness function."

nodes.speaker: pony_gpt
nodes.text: With a 97% probability — yes. The remaining 3% depend on the weather and Wi-Fi stability.
